title: The Exponential Price of Determinism in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.23837v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the complexity of finding $(\delta,\epsilon)$-Goldstein stationary points of nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz functions. By now, it is known that randomized first-order algorithms can solve this task with a dimension-free oracle complexity [Zhang et al., 2020], whereas deterministic algorithms cannot, as their complexity must scale at least linearly with the dimension $d$ [Jordan et al., 2023, Tian and So, 2024]. This leaves open whether deterministic algorithms can nevertheless solve the problem with oracle complexity polynomial in $d$. We answer this question negatively by proving a lower bound of order $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ for deterministic algorithm, closing the exponential gap between the previously known lower and upper bounds and resolving an open problem posed by Jordan et al. translated_title: 非光滑非凸优化中确定性的指数代价
translated_abstract: 我们研究了寻找非光滑非凸Lipschitz函数的 $(\delta,\epsilon)$-Goldstein驻点的复杂度。目前已知，随机一阶算法能够以与维度无关的oracle复杂度解决该任务 [Zhang et al., 2020]，而确定性算法则无法做到，因为其复杂度必须至少随维度 $d$ 线性增长 [Jordan et al., 2023, Tian and So, 2024]。这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：确定性算法是否仍能以关于 $d$ 的多项式oracle复杂度解决该问题。我们通过证明确定性算法存在量级为 $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ 的下界，对这一问题给出了否定回答，从而填补了此前已知的下界与上界之间的指数级差距，并解决了 Jordan et al. [2023] 提出的一个公开问题。我们进一步讨论了该结果对更弱驻点概念、寻找下降方向等方面的若干扩展与影响。
tldr: 该论文证明了确定性算法求解非光滑非凸优化的Goldstein驻点需要 $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ 的指数级复杂度，否定了多项式复杂度确定性算法的存在，并由此解决了Jordan等人提出的公开问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that deterministic algorithms require exponential oracle complexity of order $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ to find Goldstein stationary points in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, ruling out polynomial-complexity deterministic methods and resolving an open problem posed by Jordan et al.
